name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-castle-blocks
title: Super Mario World - Castle Blocks
description:
We should take a background and push it somewhere else make it more awesome! This castle blocks background from Super Mario World has got some parallax scrolling added with the use of layer 3 and HDMA. Make sure you read the readme! HDMA Parallax Toolkit is needed .

Use it with a custom status bar, like DKCR status bar.

No credits required!
